title: add init and rollback hooks, values schema, and templating for private installer helm chart
author: Felix Han
description: Motivation: Add formal values schema, init hook jobs and a rollback hook to the 'private' Helm chart used by Redwood Private installer to support deterministic on-prem upgrades, database migrations, and optional HSM/KMS init sequences. This PR introduces a new values.schema.json to validate user-provided values at installation time, a templated init-job that runs pre-upgrade migration and secret bootstrap steps, and a rollback hook job that runs only when Helm rollback is invoked. Changes also extend templates to support conditional KMS/HSM credentials, refactor the clusterRole/role templates to scope RBAC for init jobs, and add notes + tests for upgrade/rollback flows. Checklist: 1) Add values.schema.json with explicit types and enum constraints for storage, network and kms settings; 2) Create templates/init-job.yaml as a pre-upgrade hook (helm.sh/hook: pre-upgrade, weight: "-5"); 3) Create templates/hooks/rollback-job.yaml as a post-rollback hook; 4) Update Chart.yaml and README with configuration examples and migration notes; 5) Add unit tests (helm template + schema validation) and a small e2e playground script for local Vagrant/OpenShift testing. Migration notes: users running private installations with custom storage or kms settings should add the new `initJobs.enabled` flag to values or the chart will explicitly fail schema validation. Rollback behavior: rollback hook is opt-in via `hooks.rollback.enabled` to avoid unexpected side effects in cluster-managed environments. Testing summary: ran chart linting and schema validation in CI, fixed an initial deprecated apiVersion issue for batch/v1 Job in older clusters, and iterated on RBAC to limit permissions. See ENG-1823 and PM-87 for product acceptance criteria. Links: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1823, https://docs.redwood.ai/private/upgrade-guide (internal).

release_notes: Added values.schema.json for 'private' chart validation; new pre-upgrade init job to handle migrations and secret bootstrapping; opt-in rollback hook; RBAC scoped for init jobs; examples and upgrade notes added to README.
discussion_summary: Main thread focused on safety and upgrade determinism. Reviewers requested stricter schema validation and narrower RBAC scope. A rollback hook was initially implemented as default but changed to opt-in to avoid side effects. CI caught a deprecated Job apiVersion which was updated. Post-merge follow-ups: add a migration dry-run flag and include an e2e matrix across k8s patch versions.
upgrade_instructions: 1) Bump chart to the new version and add initJobs.enabled=true or provide values for initJobs.image and initJobs.command; 2) Run helm upgrade --install with --wait; 3) To enable rollback hook set hooks.rollback.enabled=true before running helm rollback; 4) If using KMS/HSM, populate kms.provider and kms.credentials per README; 5) For air-gapped installs ensure init job image is preloaded on nodes.
notes_for_ops: - If your cluster enforces strict PodSecurityPolicies, add the init job SA to the allowed list. - For clusters with restricted imagePullPolicies, pre-pull the init job image. - This chart will explicitly fail install if required values are missing per values.schema.json to prevent silent misconfigurations.
